data.title: UTech, Jamaica STEM Summer Camp equips youth with AI, Robotics and Sustainability Skills - Jamaica Observer
data.description: KINGSTON, Jamaica — Approximately 100 students from primary and secondary schools across Kingston and St Andrew gained hands-on experience in artificial intelligence (AI), robotics, engineering and other emerging technologies during the third staging of the University of Technology’s (UTech) STEM Summer Camp. Hosted by UTech’s Department of Community Service &amp; Development, the two-week camp was held at the University’s Western Campus from July 13–24 and at the Papine Campus from...
